A classified project by a Zone scientist. This exoskeleton blends Big Land tech with field craft into a mix of traits nobody had locked down before. A Merc Nosorog chassis was rebuilt onto an Exo System frame: the scientist Hydra handled anomaly circuits and power modules, while Kristiano — a renowned scientific researcher of the Exclusion Zone — wired the servo and plating scheme.
 
 %c[ui_gray_3]FEATURES:
 %c[d_blue] - %c[ui_gray_2] Nosorog-class bone / ballistic protection
 %c[d_blue] - %c[ui_gray_2] Sprint unlocked; Exo System PSU support
 %c[d_blue] - %c[ui_gray_2] Built-in regen and stronger chemical resist
 %c[0,100,255,150] - %c[ui_gray_2] Neutral: faction patches disabled

Decrypted assembly plans for the Kristiano KX-1 exoskeleton. Required at an expert workbench under the Exo System tab.
 
 %c[d_blue] - %c[ui_gray_2] craft recipe

Classified field-rebuild schematics for the KX-1 exoskeleton. Work by the scientist Hydra and Kristiano, a renowned scientific researcher of the Exclusion Zone. Studying this unlocks the craft under the Exo System tab.

A field flash with KX-1 schematic fragments. Data is locked: decrypting it from inventory costs a serious fee and unlocks the craft blueprint immediately.
 
 %c[d_orange] - %c[ui_gray_2] decryption required
KX-1: not enough money to decrypt the flash drive.
KX-1: Legend rank reward - encrypted schematic flash received.
